text.p: Amerin Corp, the parent company of Amerin Guaranty, said a secondary public offering of 3.5 million of its common shares was priced at $20.50 per share.

All of the shares being offered are owned by the original venture capital investors in the company, including Aetna Life Insurance Co, Leeway & Co. (a nominee for the Long Term Investment Trust, formerly known as the AT&T Master Pension Trust), Morgan Stanley Leveraged Equity Fund II L.P., First Plaza Group Trust, J.P. Morgan Capital Corp, and by Gerald Friedman, chairman and president, and Stuart Brafman, Amerin's retired president.
The offering represents 29 percent of this group's holdings in the company and 13.4 percent of the company's 26.1 million outstanding shares, the company said Thursday.
In addition, certain of the selling stockholders have granted options to U.S. underwriters to purchase a total of up to an additional 525,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
Underwriters in the United States and Canada are led by Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston Corp, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and J.P. Morgan & Co.

Morgan Stanley & Co. International Ltd, Credit Suisse First Boston (Europe) Ltd, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd. were named international underwriters for the offering outside the United States and Canada.
Amerin provides private mortgage insurance to mortgage originators.
